lcc_original: 永恆主上帝對蛇說：『你旣作了這事，就必受咒詛；比一切牲口一切野獸更重。你必用肚子走路，儘你一生的日子喫土。
notes: 耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): LCC's rendering of YHWH; WH03068 attached to 永恆主 as one unit
神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC): LCC's rendering of Elohim (WH0430)

Hebrew מִכֹּל appears twice (for livestock and beasts separately); UNV collapses to one 比一切的 with WAH04480/WAH03605. LCC explicitly renders both 一切; tags applied to first 一切 only, with the second 一切 left as LCC's own expansion
野獸 treated as a single compound in LCC (vs. UNV split 野<WH07704>獸<WH02416>); both SN tags placed after the compound
行走 (UNV) → 走路 (LCC): same Hebrew verb יָלַךְ (WH03212)
終身 (UNV, 'lifelong') → 儘你一生的日子 (LCC): Hebrew כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ expanded and reordered in LCC; distributed WAH03605→儘, WH02416→一生, WH03117→日子 to best match semantic scope
